sentences.text: Panchayat Samiti Nandishala Jan Sahbhagita Yojana
**Scheme Brief Description:** The "Panchayat Samiti Nandishala Jan Sahbhagita Yojana" was initiated to provide shelter for stray male cattle by constructing infrastructure in Panchayat Samitis.
**Who is this for:** Government Organisation, Joint Liability Groups (JLGS), Registered Societies, NGO; Category: Housing & Shelter; Sector: Shelter, integrated support and assistance

**Detailed Description:** The &quot;Panchayat Samiti Nandishala Jan Sahbhagita Yojana&quot;, launched in 2021-22, by the Animal Husbandry Department, Rajasthan, aims to support the construction of permanent infrastructure for the shelter of stray male cattle in each Panchayat Samiti. The scheme provides financial assistance for Nandishala.
**Benefits / Assistance:** - One-time assistance of 90% of the total construction cost.

**Application Process:** **Step 1:** Obtain the application form from the Office of the District Joint Director, Animal Husbandry Department. **Step 2:** Review the tender notices and apply online as per the guidelines. **Step 3:** Submit the application form along with the required documents. **Step 4:** Await verification and approval from the concerned authority. <br> > **Scheme Contact Details:** > Nodal Officer Name &amp; Designation: Dr. Anil Kaushik, Joint Director > Phone Number: 9829332050 > Email: dir.dgs@rajasthan.gov.in
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Animal Husbandry Department
